x: In the Middlesex County Championships four sprinters—Botwright, Wiley, Pritchard and yours truly, Bennett—entered and all gained County Standards.
In the Long Jump we were without the services of Skelley and Wiley last season. Charlie Jones, whilst not doing anything outstanding, managed to gain 2nd or third place in most of the matches.
Weight.—1, Higgins (BH), 34ft. 4½ins.; 2, Wiley (BH), 30ft. 10ins.; 3, Broyd (Dkg.), 30ft. 4ins. Discus.—1, Higgins (BH), 108ft. 1in.; 2, George (BH), 82ft. 8½ins.; 3, Broyd (Dkg.), 79ft. 7ins.

Fred Clay ran well in the 100 Yards and also won the Long Jump for the Club, and we were pleased to see Tom Wiley out again. Les Cohen ran a good race in the 2 Miles, and Syd Jarlett and young Dave Main beat Moody, the Police Champion, in the 880 Yards.

Two Miles. 1 Carter (BH); 2 Shaw (BH); 3 Stantup (RMC); 4 Walsh (RMC). 9m. 55.6s. Long Jump. 1 Wiley (BH); 2 McCullough (RMC); 3 De Knop (BH). 20ft. 4in. High Jump. 1 Fee (RMC); 3 Wiley (BH); 4 Powell (BH). 5ft. 7in.
100 yards (second race): 1 Pallett (W.A.C.); 2 Wiley (B.). 220 yards (first race): 1 Frost (B.); 2 Buchanan (W.A.C.).
Tom Wiley, who has been unable to compete much this season, showed us that he is still fit by gaining us valuable points in the Field Events, and helping us to win the Relay.
